text: A Maskil of Ethan the Ezrahite. 1 I will sing of the loving devotion of YHWH forever. To generation and generation I will make known Your faithfulness with my mouth.
For I have said, “Loving devotion is built up forever; the heavens—You establish Your faithfulness in them.”
“I have cut a covenant with My chosen one, I have sworn to David My servant:
‘Even to forever I will establish Your seed, and build up for generation and generation your throne.’” Selah
and the heavens will praise Your wonders, O YHWH, [and] Your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.
For who in the heavens can be compared to YHWH, likened to YHWH among the sons of the mighty?
God is to be feared greatly in the council of the holy ones, and to be revered by all those surrounding Him.
O YHWH, God of Hosts, who [is] like You, O mighty YAH? And Your faithfulness surrounds You!
You rule over the pride of the sea; its waves mount up, [and] You still them.
You crushed Rahab as one slain; with the arm of Your strength, You scattered Your enemies.
Unto You [are] the heavens; the earth also [is] unto You; the world and its fullness—You have founded them.
The north and the south, You have created them; Tabor and Hermon ring out praise in Your name.
Unto You [is] an arm with might; strong [is] Your hand; high [is] Your right hand.
Righteousness and justice [are] the foundation of Your throne; loving devotion and faithfulness go before Your face.
Blessed [are] the people knowing the joyful sound; O YHWH, in the light of Your face they walk.
In Your name they rejoice all the day, and in Your righteousness they are lifted high.
For You [are] the splendor of their strength, and by Your favor our horn is raised high.
Indeed, unto YHWH [is] our shield, and our king unto the Holy One of Israel.
Once You spoke in a vision to Your holy ones, and said: “I have given help to a mighty one; I have exalted one chosen from the people.
I have found David My servant; with the oil of My holiness I anointed him,
with whom My hand is established—My arm also will strengthen him.
The enemy will not exact tribute from him, and a son of wickedness shall not afflict him.
And I will crush his foes before his face, and those hating him I will strike.
And My faithfulness and My loving devotion [are] with him, and in My name his horn will be exalted.
And I will set his hand over the sea, and his right hand over the rivers.
He will call to Me, ‘You [are] My Father, my God, and the Rock of my salvation.’
I also appoint him firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
Forever I will keep for him My loving devotion, and My covenant will stand fast for him.
And I will establish His seed forever, and his throne like the days of the heavens.
If his sons should abandon My instruction, and do not walk in My ordinances,
if they violate My statutes, and do not keep My commandments,
then I will attend [to] their transgression with the rod, and [to] their iniquity with stripes.
And I will not break off My loving devotion from him, and I will not be false in My faithfulness.
I will not violate My covenant, and a declaration of My lips I will not change.
Once I have sworn by My holiness—I will not lie to David—
His seed shall be forever, and his throne like the sun before Me.
Like the moon It will be established forever, even [as] the faithful witness in the sky.” Selah
and You have cast away and rejected; You have been enraged with Your anointed.
You have renounced the covenant of Your servant; You have defiled his diadem on the ground.
You have broken down all his walls; You have set his strongholds [to] ruin.
All passing by the way plunder him; he has become a reproach to his neighbors.
You have raised high the right hand of his adversaries; all of his enemies You have made glad.
Also You have turned back the sharpness of his sword, and You have not made it stand in the battle.
You have made his brightness cease, and You have cast down his throne to the ground.
You have shortened the days of his youth; You have covered over him [with] shame. Selah
until when, O YHWH? Will You hide Yourself forever? Will Your rage keep burning like fire?
Remember me—how [short] a lifetime; for what emptiness You created all the sons of men!
What man can live and not see death? Can he deliver his soul from the hand of Sheol? Selah
where [is] Your loving devotion [is] Your Of old, O Lord, which You swore of David in Your faithfulness?
Remember, O Lord, the reproach of Your servants—I bear in my bosom from all the many peoples,
with which Your enemies have taunted, O YHWH, with which they have reproached the footsteps of Your anointed one.
Blessed [be] YHWH forever! Amen and Amen.
